incorrect_clause: a fresh source reuses the relation without reusing whole, occurrence, channel or residual identities
cause: The existing WholeCut6 formation rule requires the residual ledger to equal the ordered residuals of open ports. A closed source accepted by LineView has no open ports and therefore necessarily has the empty residual ledger. Distinct residual identities cannot exist in this domain.
correction: Require distinct whole, occurrence and channel identities in the fresh closed source, while requiring both closed sources to retain their exact empty residual ledger.
scope_change: none; the object domain, grammar, route count and budgets are unchanged
